## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes (build, tests, lint)
- [ ] New durable behavior has domain/replay tests (projections rebuild identically)
- [ ] If this touches the design, docs/architecture/ (authoritative) and the relevant ADRs are updated
- [ ] Protocol changes are additive and versioned (see docs/architecture/02-design-laws.md)
